work.note: First printed quarto (Q1), not the composition date or the text used unaltered by modern editions. Q2 followed in 1604 and F1 in 1623. Folger: https://www.folger.edu/explore/shakespeares-works/hamlet/

composition.note: Existing RSC source-record notes explicitly give composition circa 1600–1601; 001000 separately distinguishes the 1603 quarto, 1604/1605 quarto and 1623 Folio.
composition.label: c. 1600–1601

description: Reconstructs the tragedy of revenge at the Danish court and examines evidence, performance, surveillance, and political power. Covers The Ghost and the Court; The Play and the Closet; The Return and the Deaths; Sources, Texts, and the Life of a Play.
